bbags.configuration.commonOdds.tooltip: Chance of Common Loot Bags dropping, as 1 in X kills (0 disables it)
bbags.configuration.diminishingReturns.t: Lower drop chances for players who kill lots of mobs in a short time
bbags.configuration.drops.tooltip: Loot Bag drop chances when a player kills a hostile mob
bbags.configuration.epicOdds.tooltip: Chance of Epic Loot Bags dropping, as 1 in X kills (0 disables it)
bbags.configuration.farming.tooltip: Limits that stop mob farms from generating Loot Bags
bbags.configuration.healthTierBase.toolt: Health tiers are this x 2^n + this (20 gives 40, 60, 100, 180, 340, 660...), every tier a mob's max health reaches upgrades the Loot Bag by one rarity (0 disables it)
bbags.configuration.healthTierBonus.tool: Drop chance multiplier for each health tier a mob reaches (2.0 doubles it every tier)
bbags.configuration.killLimit.tooltip: Recent kills a player can have before their drop chances go down (at twice this many, chances are halved)
bbags.configuration.killsForgottenPerMin: How much a player's recent kill count goes down each minute
bbags.configuration.legendaryOdds.toolti: Chance of Legendary Loot Bags dropping, as 1 in X kills (0 disables it)
bbags.configuration.loot.tooltip: What comes out of Loot Bags when opened
bbags.configuration.lootingBonus.tooltip: Extra drop chance per Looting level (1.0 makes Looting III 4x more likely)
bbags.configuration.maxEnvironmentDamage: Mobs that took more than this share of their max health from non-player damage (falling, drowning, cramming...) drop no Loot Bags (1.0 disables it)
bbags.configuration.maxItemDamage.toolti: Most durability tools and armor from Loot Bags can be missing (0.75 = 75% damaged)
bbags.configuration.minItemDamage.toolti: Least durability tools and armor from Loot Bags can be missing (0.5 = 50% damaged)
bbags.configuration.rareOdds.tooltip: Chance of Rare Loot Bags dropping, as 1 in X kills (0 disables it)
bbags.configuration.skipSpawnerMobs.tool: Mobs from monster spawners never drop Loot Bags
bbags.configuration.uncommonOdds.tooltip: Chance of Uncommon Loot Bags dropping, as 1 in X kills (0 disables it)
